title: M1000RR Competition (Apex Spec)
description: Representing BMW Motorrad's engineering ethos in the Homologation Superbike class, the BMW Motorrad M1000RR Competition (Apex Spec) is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. At its heart lies a 1000cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its chassis dynamics into punchy mid-range acceleration. An aggressive Aggressive Forward Tuck layout places rider weight decisively over the front axle with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, maximizing cornering feedback at apex speeds.
